system_type: Web app (Vue.js SPA + Express REST API)

architecture_pattern.name: MVC (Model-View-Controller)
architecture_pattern.description: Simple, three-tier MVC pattern well-suited for a small, single-user web application. No need for complex patterns like CLEAN or Hexagonal — the app has one entity (Task) and basic CRUD operations.

components.name: View (Vue.js SPA)
components.role: Renders the UI, handles user interactions, sends HTTP requests to the backend

components.name: Controller (Express Routes)
components.role: Receives HTTP requests, delegates to service layer, returns JSON responses

components.name: Service (Business Logic)
components.role: Handles task CRUD operations, validates input

components.name: Model (SQLite + better-sqlite3)
components.role: Persists and retrieves task data from SQLite

tech_stack.choice: better-sqlite3 (direct SQL, no ORM needed for single-entity app)
Database auto-sync on startup (simple schema check)

nfr.requirement: No uptime SLA required — local app running on demand

architecture_notes: Choosing better-sqlite3 (synchronous) over an ORM keeps the stack minimal and avoids abstraction overhead for a single-entity app. Database schema is auto-created on first run — no migration tool needed at this scale.
